messages:
sanjay: Heads-up: marketplace GPU image failing perf tests after partner upgrade to CUDA 12.2. Observed throughput drop and OOMs on 48-token sequences. Repro on our dedicated infra.

elaine: seeing same on canary. driver 535.86.08 + CUDA 12.2. Regression appears in cuBLAS kernel selection.

jordan: Logs show `nccl` warnings and `illegal memory access` in quant kernels. Could be driver ABI change. Can we pin driver in marketplace images to 525.x for now?

nvidia_ops_bot: Auto-detection: Partner reported CUDA 12.2 kernel ABI change affecting our runtime. Linking partner ticket: https://partner.tix/PR-3421

marta_partner_pm: @sanjay thanks, we're triaging. NV team confirmed a regression introduced in 535.86.x on A100s. They'll prepare a hotfix. ETA 48h. Do you need a workaround?

sanjay: Yes we need workaround for marketplace listings. Proposal: temporary driver pin to `nvidia-driver:525.85.12` in VM images and container base for Marketplace 2.0. Also add runtime fallback policy.

elaine: I'll open a quick PR to update marketplace image tags and add a `DRIVER_PIN=525` build arg. Minimal change and revert later. Will also add note in release notes.

jordan: We should also add canary gating: run perf suite on 10% of traffic, and rollback if latency > 2x baseline. I can add alert.

marta_partner_pm: We'll coordinate announcement. If hotfix lands earlier, we'll plan a joint patch note. Need timeline for marketplace update and ETA for partner hotfix.

sanjay: Timeline: PR in 1h, CI builds 30m, roll to canary in 2h, full rollout 6h post-canary if green. I'll mark dedicated customers and engage account teams.

ops-bot: Deploy plan created: https://deploys/redwood/plan/2055551234. Canary 10%, rollback hook enabled.

marta_partner_pm: :thumbsup: Thanks all. We'll push partner hotfix to QA and ping once validated. Please add me to status channel #marketplace-hotfix.

elaine: Added @marta_partner_pm to #marketplace-hotfix and created a one-page runbook in Confluence. Steps, TL;DR included.

jordan: One more: let's add an explicit note in the marketplace listing UI about supported driver versions to avoid future surprises.

sanjay: Agreed. I'll add a follow-up task to product. Thanks team :rocket:
